What the loop guarantees (from the docs)
• A correct answer alone does not advance the child: reasoning is assessed (memorised vs understood vs transfer).
• A misconception moves suspected → confirmed → resolved only on repeated evidence, never on one ambiguous answer.
• A representation that fails (≥ 3 uses, mean < 0.3) is avoided; the strategy profile decays 0.9 per 30 days.
